schedule: greedy first history-eligible issue, then first eligible issue at least 60 minutes after the previous scheduled issue; schedule uses all eligible times including missing-target issues
residual: actual minus unadapted population forecast; use only at issue+horizon+target delay
correction: exponentially time-weighted clipped residual sum divided by weight sum plus zero-residual prior weight; clip correction; add to unadapted forecast
missing_scheduled_target: no update; do not substitute a later issue from the same interval
warmup_and_outages: no correction before minimum updates within trailing history or after latest matured update expires; fall back to unchanged baseline
patient_separation: independent state per held-out patient, horizon and method; no population model refitting
evaluation: same v2 exact endpoint rows, folds, predictions and targets; score all rows plus matched adaptation-active subsets; no outcome-driven row admission
selection: one fixed research rule declared before running; no parameter sweep or final-test selection
